name: Philippine Islands
locator: Bulletin 149, printed p. 16, Table 13 discussion, and Table 17, Philippine Islands
definition: Estimated population of the Philippine archipelago. The extent of the 1898 treaty boundary and the coverage of outlying islands are unresolved.
method: Extrapolation from 496 comparable 1887 and 1896 towns, addition for new towns and an upper-end allowance for omitted peoples. No population adjustment from 1896 to the nominal table date.

name: Philippine Islands, Gazetteer
locator: Printed p. 27, List of islands, provinces, and populations; printed pp. 28–31, subordinate tables and supplementary comparison
definition: Gazetteer archipelago estimate compiled from older enumeration and later local estimates. It includes the source's geographic residual.

definition: Published total for the Gazetteer's island group. The groups include old administrative geography and an unaligned residual.

name: Philippine Islands, Spanish census coverage
locator: Printed p. 29, Progress of Philippine Population
definition: Published total coverage of the Spanish civil census. Excluded or insufficiently enumerated groups remained outside the count.
method: Published summary of Spanish civil census

name: Philippine Islands, partial 1896 returns
locator: Printed p. 31, partial census summary, and pp. 31–49, Towns (pueblos)
definition: Return coverage for 37 reporting areas in the interrupted Spanish census. These areas include gaps in town reporting.
method: Published summary of partial Spanish census returns

name: Philippine Islands, estimated 1896 covered population
locator: Bulletin 149, printed p. 16, Table 13 discussion, and Table 17, Philippine Islands
definition: Population reconstructed from 496 comparable towns, with additions for newly organized towns. This is the pre-allowance component of the 6,961,339 estimate.

name: Philippine Islands, Commission national estimate
locator: Introduction, Population, national estimate in paragraph preceding table
definition: The Commission stated this archipelago-wide approximate estimate above a separate compilation of local figures.
